3. In the facts and circumstances of the case, if a temporary  bail for a period of one month is granted, the State or the  complainant would not suffer a loss.

 ORDER (i) Bail Application is allowed.

(iii) During his temporary bail, he shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses and promptly surrender before the Jail Authority after one (1) month is over.

(v) Criminal application No.77 of 2023 to assist the learned APP is allowed.
